info.title: Virtual_Network_ID
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

aclv4_routed_in_applied.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
Current, successfully applied routed ingress IPv4 ACL to this VNI as identified in the [ACL](#/ACL).

aclv4_routed_in_cfg.description:
Reference Resource: [ACL](#/ACL)
IPv4 ACL for routed ingress traffic, potentially in flight desired to be applied to this VNI, as identified in the [ACL](#/ACL). This configuration is applicable only when the VNI is an L3 VNI. An empty column value indicates that no list is applied for this type and direction.

aclv4_routed_in_cfg_version.description: The version of the 'aclv4_routed_in_cfg' column. This value is changed to a random value each time any management interface modifies the 'aclv4_routed_in_cfg' value. An empty column value will indicate that the user does not want the system to process this configuration yet.

aclv4_routed_in_data_plane_states.description:
Reference Resource: [Data_Plane](#/Data_Plane)
Routed ingress IPv4 ACL application status for each data_plane (line card).

aclv4_routed_in_status.description: The status of the last version of 'aclv4_routed_in_cfg' column, that has been processed by switchd.

code.description: Numeric error code.  Expected to be 0 when state is 'applied'.

message.description: Detailed reason for error state. Expected empty when state is 'applied'.

version.description: The version of aclv4_routed_in_cfg that corresponds to this status.

aclv6_routed_in_applied.description:

Current, successfully applied routed ingress IPv6 ACL to this VNI as identified in the [ACL](#/ACL).

aclv6_routed_in_cfg.description:

IPv6 ACL for routed ingress traffic, potentially in flight desired to be applied to this VNI, as identified in the [ACL](#/ACL). This configuration is applicable only when the VNI is an L3 VNI. An empty column value indicates that no list is applied for this type and direction.

Routed ingress IPv6 ACL application status for each data_plane (line card).

aclv6_routed_in_status.description: The status of the last version of 'aclv6_routed_in_cfg' column, that has been processed by switchd.

code.description: Numeric error code.  Expected to be 0 when state is 'applied'.

message.description: Detailed reason for error state. Expected empty when state is 'applied'.

version.description: The version of aclv6_routed_in_cfg that corresponds to this status.

hsc_service_nodes.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
List of VTEPs to be used as service nodes for BUM traffic replication, as instructed by HSC. If empty, traffic would be replicated to all VTEPs available for VNI.

interface.description:
Reference Resource: [Interface](#/Interface)
Interface (VXLAN etc.) that is associated with the Network ID.

policy_routed_in_applied.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy](#/Policy)
Current, successfully applied routed ingress policy to this VNI, as identified in the policy.

policy_routed_in_cfg.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy](#/Policy)
Classifier policy for routed ingress traffic, potentially in flight, desired to be applied to this VNI, as identified in the policy. An empty column value indicates that no list is applied for this type and direction.

policy_routed_in_cfg_version.description: The version of 'policy_routed_in_cfg'. This value is changed to a random value each time any management interface modifies the 'policy_routed_in_cfg' value. An empty column value will indicate that the user does not want the system to process this configuration yet.

policy_routed_in_data_plane_states.description:
Reference Resource: [Data_Plane](#/Data_Plane)
Routed ingress policy application status for each data_plane (line card).

policy_routed_in_status.description: The status of the last version of 'policy_routed_in_cfg', that has been processed by daemon that programs hardware.

code.description: Numeric error code. Expected to be 0 when state is 'applied'

message.description: Detailed reason for error state. Expected empty when state is 'applied'

version.description: The version of policy_routed_in_cfg that corresponds to this status.

replication_group.description:
Reference Resource: [Replication_Group](#/Replication_Group)
Multicast replication group used for this virtual network.

routing.description: If set to 'true' symmetric routing is enabled on the network ID.

state.description: Status of this virtual network ID: 'operational':         network ID is fully provisioned in the forwarding path 'configuration_error': network ID provisioning failed due to misconfiguration 'no_hw_resources':     network ID provisioning failed due to insufficient resources 'activating':          network ID is being provisioned

type.description:
Reference Resource: [Virtual_Network_ID](#/Virtual_Network_ID)
Type of the network identifier.

vlan.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
VLAN to be mapped to the layer 2 specific network ID.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
This field takes effect only if 'routing' is enabled on the network ID. Unless specified explicitly the network ID gets mapped to 'default' VRF.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
